translations.en: Salama ibn al-Khattab, al-Barawastani, Abu Muhammad, from Sawad al-Ray. Weak.

en.summary: This entry from al-Ghada'iri's *Kitab al-Duafa* identifies Salama ibn al-Khattab al-Barawastani as a narrator from the scholarly hub of Sawad al-Ray, noting his nisba to Barawastan which indicates his regional origin. The classification of 'weak' (da'if) reflects the rigorous scrutiny applied by Shia hadith scholars to ensure the authenticity of transmitted traditions, particularly regarding narrators from the broader Iraqi scholarly circles.
en.seo_question: Who is Salama ibn al-Khattab al-Barawastani and what is his status in hadith sciences?

key_terms.ضَعِيفٌ: Weak (a technical term in hadith sciences indicating lower reliability)
